choice.definition:
n. the person or thing chosen or selected
n. the act of choosing or selecting
s. of superior grade
s. appealing to refined taste
choice.translation:
n. 选择, 精选品, 选择权
a. 精选的, 挑三拣四的, 上等的
[计] DOS内部命令:在批处理文件中
该命令用于提示用户作出选择, 决定批处理文件的流程

choicely.translation: adv. 精选地, 七挑八选地

choiceness.definition: n the quality of being very good indeed

choicer.definition:
s. of superior grade
s. appealing to refined taste
choicer.translation: choice（上等的, 精选的）的比较级形式

choices.definition:
n the person or thing chosen or selected
n the act of choosing or selecting
n one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen

choicest.definition:
s of superior grade
s appealing to refined taste
choicest.translation: choice（上等的, 精选的）的最高级形式

choicest quality.translation: [经] 精选质量, 特级品

choir.definition:
n. a chorus that sings as part of a religious ceremony
n. a family of similar musical instrument playing together
n. the area occupied by singers; the part of the chancel between sanctuary and nave
v. sing in a choir
choir.translation:
n. 唱诗班, 唱诗班的席位
v. 合唱

choir loft.translation: [网络] 唱诗席；唱经台；楼台唱诗座

choirboy.definition: n. a boy who sings in a choir

choirboys.definition: n. a boy who sings in a choir
choirboys.translation: n. （唱诗班的）少年歌者( choirboy的复数形式 )

choirloft.translation: n. (某些教堂中的)唱诗班楼座

choirman.translation: n. 唱诗班成员；合唱队队员

choirmaster.definition: n. the musical director of a choir

choirmasters.definition: n. the musical director of a choir
choirmasters.translation: n. 唱诗班指挥( choirmaster的复数形式 )

choirmen.translation: (choirman 的复数) n. 唱诗班成员；合唱队队员

choirs.definition:
n. a chorus that sings as part of a religious ceremony

choirs.translation: n. 教堂的唱诗班( choir的复数形式 ); 唱诗队; 公开表演的合唱团; （教堂）唱经楼
